followup_explanation: This is a well-specified extraction/identification task with clear completion criteria — "identify three aspects" with an explicit instruction to be concise. That matches Plover's self-reported top-rated task family (well-specified retrieval and extraction with clear stopping points), and Plover holds a slight edge on the Extraction & Retrieval eval, though the gap is within variance. Avocet's distinguishing strength is in harm-adjacent content, which isn't relevant here. So Plover was the cleaner fit.
